name: Krishna Defence & Allied Industries Ltd
tagline: Debt-free naval/submarine-components small-cap with clean cash flows and real AUV/composites optionality, but a thin order book, a Q1 FY27 revenue decline, and a full multiple
business_overview: Krishna Defence & Allied Industries (NSE main board since Dec-2025) supplies critical components (bulb bars, composite doors/hatches via a JV with VABO Composites, and AUV/submarine-platform fabrication with CSIR-NIO tech transfer) to the Indian Navy and shipbuilders, alongside a small, shrinking legacy Dairy-equipment segment (<3% of revenue).
fundamentals_table: FY26 +29.1% (Rs 245 Cr); FY25 +113%; but Q1 FY27 revenue -15.2% YoY (Rs 57.6 Cr) on a lumpy order book
FY26 PAT Rs 41.3 Cr (+85.6%); EBITDA Rs 52 Cr (+69.9%), margin 21.3% (+511 bps); Q1 FY27 OPM ~26%
Rs 103 Cr at 31-Mar-2026 (book-to-bill <0.5x) + Rs 221 Cr tender pipeline; Rs 45.6 Cr MoD naval order won Jun-2026
Near debt-free (Rs 2 Cr); FY26 OCF Rs 86 Cr > EBITDA; FCF Rs 66 Cr; Rs 65 Cr in FDs
Inventory days ~47, WC days 53.4 (both sharply improved from the ~270 inventory-days flag of early 2026)
fundamentals_narrative: FY26 delivery was strong (revenue +29%, PAT +86%, EBITDA margin +511 bps to 21.3%) on a near debt-free balance sheet, and the working-capital concern raised in early 2026 has materially eased -- screener.in now shows inventory days ~47 and working-capital days 53.4 (versus the ~270 inventory-days figure a community analyst flagged), with FY26 operating cash flow of Rs 86 Cr exceeding EBITDA and FCF of Rs 66 Cr. Against that, Q1 FY27 revenue fell 15.2% YoY to Rs 57.6 Cr (PAT still +20.7% on an OPM that jumped to ~26%), the confirmed order book is only Rs 103 Cr at 31-Mar-2026 -- under 0.5x FY26 revenue -- and the stock trades at ~36.6x trailing earnings, so the 30%+ growth guidance is running well ahead of bookings and the current margin looks closer to a cyclical peak than a floor.

deep_dive.conviction_update: Medium-High -> Medium-High. Net neutral: the deep read retires a genuine bear point (working-capital/inventory-days concern now resolved, CFO > EBITDA, main-board migration done) but adds an equally material one (Q1 FY27 revenue -15% YoY, order book only Rs 103 Cr, margins near a likely peak, 36x P/E). Thesis-fit cut to 'neither' -- a lumpy sub-0.5x book-to-bill and a shrinking latest quarter do not support a 10x-in-2-3-years call, though AUV/composites/submarine catalysts in FY27 could revive it on a bookings inflection.

sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 55 fetched posts (2024-06 to 2026-08, essentially the thread's full history given it is young), single batch (first-time read). This is a genuinely high-conviction, heavily-tracked small-cap defence story among trusted users -- consistent order-book growth, expanding product lines (composite hatches, AUV/submarine bulb-bar technology via JVs with VABO Composites and tech transfer from CSIR-NIO), and sector tailwinds crystallizing further with a May-2026 Rs 70,000 Cr government submarine deal (MDL + thyssenkrupp). The one repeated caution across trusted posters is that despite strong narrative/order pipeline, the company still needs to convert this into 'concrete orders' at scale -- the FY26 filings bear this out, with a confirmed order book of only Rs 103 Cr.
community_signal: rajpanda (trusted, elevated) was the most detailed, consistent, and highly-rated tracker throughout -- covering order-book growth (Rs 187 Cr to Rs 3,326 Cr additions), major orders from L&T and Ministry of Defence, the VABO Composites JV, and CSIR-NIO tech transfer for AUV development, plus a July-2026 concall on commercial shipbuilding as a new growth vector. Naman_Gupta1 (trusted, elevated) gave a well-received company overview (Dec 2024). Sudarsan93 (trusted, elevated) was the consistent voice of caution, twice noting the company 'still needs to win some concrete orders' despite strong guidance, and flagging unresolved confusion between the Krishna/Rekise Marine/SAIL AUV platform relationships. paragbharambe (non-trusted, but detailed) flagged genuinely elevated inventory days (~270 vs typical 120-180) as a real working-capital red flag in a March-2026 balance sheet analysis -- the FY26 numbers show this has since improved sharply. ankiur.jain83 (trusted, elevated) flagged the May-2026 Rs 70,000 Cr submarine deal as a potential order-book trigger.

trusted_signals.note: Order book grew from Rs 187 Cr (start of FY25) with major additions from L&T (Rs 105 Cr) and MoD (Rs 88 Cr); strong quarterly numbers likely to continue.
Company has laid strong foundations (design stake, defence electronics, PLI, DRDO tech transfers) but still needs to convert this into concrete, reported orders to move the stock further.
Government's Rs 70,000 Cr, 6-submarine deal (MDL + thyssenkrupp) could be a meaningful order-book trigger for Krishna given its naval/submarine platform work.

bse_notes: Mar-Aug 2026: Rs 45.64 Cr MoD naval order (Jun-2026); NSE main-board migration completed Dec-2025; Rs 1.25 final dividend approved at 13th AGM (Jul-2026); India SME Forum award (Aug-2026). No pledge creation, rating action, or auditor/KMP change found.
bull_case: FY26 delivery was strong and clean: revenue +29%, PAT +86%, EBITDA margin +511 bps to 21.3%, near debt-free, FY26 OCF Rs 86 Cr exceeding EBITDA and FCF Rs 66 Cr
The early-2026 working-capital concern has largely resolved (inventory days ~270 -> ~47, WC days 53.4), and the NSE main-board migration (Dec-2025) removes the SME-platform overhang

Extensive, credible trusted-community tracking with concrete order-book documentation, not just narrative

Valuation is full at ~36.6x trailing P/E and ~7.9x P/B for a company that just printed a revenue decline

verdict_headline: Clean balance sheet and genuine AUV/composites optionality, but a thin order book, a shrinking latest quarter, and a full multiple put the 10x thesis on hold
verdict_reasoning: FY26 was a strong, cash-generative year and the working-capital concern that dogged the earlier write-up has largely resolved -- so the balance-sheet quality case is intact

Medium-High conviction held: the deep read swaps one bear point (working capital) for another (Q1 FY27 revenue -15% YoY, order book only Rs 103 Cr, margins near a likely peak) -- roughly a wash, on a still-credible, heavily-tracked story

Thesis-fit downgraded to 'neither': a lumpy sub-0.5x book-to-bill and a declining latest quarter do not support 10x-in-2-3-years at 36x earnings; AUV/composites/submarine catalysts in FY27 could restore the thesis on a clear bookings inflection
